description: Given the contents of a robots.txt file and a path, report whether the generic (User-agent: *) rules permit crawling it, along with the crawl delay, the disallowed patterns and any sitemaps. Takes the file contents directly and makes no network request of its own — fetch robots.txt with your own HTTP tool and pass what it returned.

content.description: The contents of the robots.txt file.

maxResults.description: Cap on returned disallowed paths (default 500). meta.truncated reports whether any were dropped.

path.description: The path to check, e.g. "/admin". A full URL is accepted and reduced to its path.

name: analyze_robots_txt
